overview: ICR's own work, reviewing companies and mentors, moderating, setting plans and prices, granting roles, is done in the admin consoles on the website. The app gives a staff account a read of the member-facing side.
Staff with roles granted from the Role Management console, such as a support agent or a content reviewer, see an ordinary member's menu in the app; their consoles are on the website too.
website: Every admin console: verification, approvals, subscriptions, roles and permissions, the audit trail, translations, and the rest of the Admin Portal.
